verdict.rationale: BILL's API Reference lets users view sample code in their chosen language and test API calls directly in the docs (docs-52). Interactive recipes take sandbox credentials and chain endpoint outputs into inputs (docs-53), backed by a sandbox environment (docs-15) and a forkable Postman collection (docs-51). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the in-docs try-it works, and explicit confirmation that runnable examples cover the Spend & Expense endpoints specifically.
